reviews.text: we travel to them for their brilliant service
Absolutely brilliant groom for my two yorkies Bailey and bear,, they looked amazing 🐾🐾 …

Took them my 2 dogs and I was so happy about the outcome!!! Loved the way the looked 💖
They well took care of them 🥹
FYI for 2 small dogs I paid 170 euros. I don't know if this is the average but I would pay again for sure!!! 🙏🏽
The only inconvenience is that there are no parking slots and it was a bit hard to find a car spot not too far, but that's not on them 😔
Very good nice and helpful  great people thanks for everything
Dropped in my cat Ivy to be groomed, her fur was quite matted in places but they did a fantastic job! Really happy with the results, as is Ivy!
Thanks for another fab groom for Tilly.
Had my pet Bee groomed today at Pet Stylist. She looks amazing. One of the few places that knows how to groom a wire haired dog!

So happy with the way our cocker spaniel is groomed at dogsbody. Justin the owner  usually does him but for the last two times Sarah has groomed him beautifully. We are very pleased with the service.. Friendly staff and wonderful groomers. Thank you all at terenure.

The girls are amazing. Brought my rescue jack Russell who is normally afraid of people, not a bother on him. So brought back my other two to get their nails clipped. The dogs were so calm, couldn't recommend this place highly enough.
I used pet stylist today for the first time for my cat to get a lion mane, I was only delighted with the results , I definitely use  pet stylists again they done a brilliant job 👏🏻 …
Both my dogs groomed today by the Pet Stylist. They look and smell great. Two happy doggies.
We had our first grooming recently  with Mariia, she did a great job with my shih-tzu and she offered to prebook for Christmas as well. Booking system is handy, will be back.
